chapter_title: He Came Wrapped in Something Sacred
title: Anthon Walker McFadden
quote: His name was Anthon Walker McFadden, but we called him Walker, and there was never a name that fit a boy better. Walker was the light in every room he entered.
caption: A newborn photograph of Walker, brought home from the hospital. Not yet in the archive.

title: Fifty-four more feet
quote: And as I knelt there in the weeds, leaning on the faith that was planted in me all those years ago in Hawaii at the bottom of Honolua Bay, pleading, I heard, as clearly as any conversation I have ever had in my life, a voice behind me. I thought, in that moment, that it was my neighbor Steve, walking up behind me. The voice said: "54 more feet."
caption: Rob telling the well story on video, the framed peppercorn gravel with its brass plaque, and the house at The Acres.

quote: And then he turned to something far more serious, something I will carry for the rest of my life. Of Walker's passing, he said: "This is not tragic. It's very, very sad. It's very disappointing, but it's not tragic. Tragedies have terrible endings, and this has a perfect ending."

quote: Weeks later, a sketch arrived at our home from a young woman we did not even know, Caitlin Anderson, who had felt inspired to draw the very scene that had been revealed to us: our boy, gathered into the arms of his Savior. She had no earthly way of knowing what we had been shown.
